'''Storm Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the lead [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE/Advanced]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] of [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]], a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] with recruitment based out of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
As a member of one of the more elite of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], Storm Leader's [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE/Advanced]] boasted more damaging [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] and better maneuverability over other TIE Advanced [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in the squadron. This advantage, however, came at the expense of accuracy to [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting systems]].

==Behind the scenes==
Storm Leader was the name of a TIE Advanced starship miniature in [[WizKids Games]] initial release of the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|''Star Wars PocketModel TCG'']]. WizKids often previewed new&mdash;or included existing&mdash;[[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] material from other published ''[[Star Wars]]'' brands and titles, including the [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']] game, from which Storm Squadron is featured.
